channel.description: What officeholders said each day from or about California, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, California, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Alex Padilla)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Alex Padilla, U.S. Senator: “Medicaid is the largest payer of mental health services in the country.” Unsettled. MACPAC calls Medicaid the single largest payer for behavioral health services, including mental health and substance use, at 26% of such spending in 2009, a broader category than mental health alone.

item.title: Said & Checked, California, 2026-11-18: 1 contradicted (Darrell Issa)
item.description:
False or contradicted

  • Darrell Issa, U.S. Representative from California: “Currently the Bureau of Land Management spends a not insignificant number of dollars every year and growing maintaining 847 acres of land that earns no money” Contradicted. The text of H.R. 8483 in the Congressional Record divides the approximately 847 acres into about 164 acres of Bureau of Land Management land ('Parcel 1') and about 683 acres of Forest Service land ('Parcels 2 and 3'), so BLM does not manage all 847 acres. The total acreage matches. The record gives no revenue or maintenance-cost figures, so 'earns no money' was not tested.
